sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 當前 Kalos Pokédex 明列 Pumpkaboo/Gourgeist 四尺寸、普通與 Hisuian Avalugg、Zygarde 10%/50%/Complete、Diancie/Mega Diancie、Hoopa Confined/Unbound 與 Volcanion 等 exact forms 為 Released: Yes。
Available Shadow Pokémon roster 正面列出 Shadow Noibat 與可由其進化的 Shadow Noivern；本批其他 form 未以 absence 推成未推出。
Purified 只由同 exact form 已確認 Shadow 加官方淨化機制推導。

boundary: All 22 NORMAL exact forms in #710-#721 have positive current-roster evidence. Four Pumpkaboo/Gourgeist sizes, three Zygarde forms and both Hoopa forms remain isolated. Only Shadow/Purified Noibat and Noivern are positive. Mega Diancie is positive; the species-level Mega Zygarde No row is intentionally not projected onto 10%/50%/Complete because the exact base-form association is ambiguous in this candidate model. Max Battle counter simulations are never treated as release evidence, so Dynamax/Gigantamax remain UNKNOWN without a positive roster identity.
